sources: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/LongPointPark (read in a browser, incl. its Camping, Rates and Rules tabs)

values.note: Brevard County residents $34.25/night all year; non-residents $48.50, or $50.81 in the November 1 - April 30 season, before 7% sales and 5% tourist tax. Premium site fee $2/day for a water-access site (93 at Long Point) or any site with sewer, residents and non-residents alike. Late check-out (after 11 am) is charged a night; cancellation $20 plus a sliding refund fee.

fees.source: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/LongPointPark Rates tab ('Brevard County Resident Daily Camping Rates ... Long Point $34.25 $34.25', 'Brevard County Non-Resident Daily Camping Rates ... Long Point $48.50 $50.81', 'Water Access/Water View $2.00 daily, Sewage Site Fee (Campers) $2.00 daily', 'Seasonal rates apply from November 1 through April 30') + Rules tab ('Premium Site Fees: Applies to any of the 93 sites at Long Point Park with water access ... This fee applies to residents and non-residents equally'), read 2026-10-21

hookups.source: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/LongPointPark Camping tab ('113 waterfront semi-improved campsites (water and electric), 17 improved campsites (water, electric and sewer), 40 semi-improved campsites (water and electric)'), read 2026-10-21; amperage not stated

values.note: 113 waterfront and 40 other semi-improved sites with water and electric, 17 improved sites with sewer too (the rules tab counts 93 water-access premium sites).

facilities.source: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/LongPointPark Camping tab ('Campground Features Showers, Laundry facilities ... Free WiFi'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/LongPointPark Camping tab ('Long Point Campground offers RV and Tent camping. A get-away all year-round for families and day visitors'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Brevard County's own WebTrac booking site, or in person, by email or phone (321-952-4532). Brevard County residents may book 395 days (13 months) ahead, non-residents 180 days (6 months). Up to 14 days per reservation, then 48 hours away before returning. Check-in 2-9 pm, check-out 11 am.

booking.source: https://www.brevardfl.gov/ParksAndRecreation/Campgrounds/LongPointPark ('Book a Campground' -> registration.brevardfl.gov/webtrac; 'Brevard County residents can reserve up to 395 days (13 months) in advance, while non-residents can book up to 180 days (6 months) in advance'; 'Long Point Park Campground's maximum length of stay is 14 days for all campers'; 'The minimum length of stay is one night'; 'Check-in is from 2:00 PM until 9:00 PM. Check-out is 11:00 AM'), read 2026-10-21

note: Brevard County park on an island in the Indian River Lagoon near Sebastian Inlet. Almost all waterfront. --AWH  The bridge to Scout Island (nature trails, youth group camp) is closed for Hurricane Milton damage (county page, 2026-10-21). --Claude
summary: County page: added resident $34.25 base, non-resident +$14.25 ($48.50; $50.81 Nov-Apr), $2 water-access and $2 sewer premiums, water/sewer hookups, showers/laundry/WiFi, year-round, WebTrac booking with 395-day resident window and 14-night max; confirmed 170 sites (113 waterfront + 17 full + 40). Not stated: amperage, site lengths. No Hurricane Isaias closure posted.
flags: AWH note says 'almost all waterfront'; the county's camping tab counts 113 of 170 sites as waterfront and its rules tab says 93 sites carry the water-access premium. Not a contrary claim against the entry's riverfront value, but the share is about half to two-thirds.
Non-resident seasonal rate $50.81 (Nov-Apr) is just over US$50; the gate does not apply to a county park.
